events.title: The Dojo & Werewolf’s Den Are Here!
events.summary: Hey everyone!Our latest major update is live! Train your heroes in the new Dojo, experiment with talent builds, and take your party into Werewolf’s Den. events.title: We've reached 2,000 wishlists!
events.summary: Hello, heroes!Today we have a very special reason to celebrate: My Own Hero Party has reached 2,000 wishlists on Steam! 🎉Everyone who added the game to their wishlist helped us get here. Seeing so many people interested in the project is a huge motivation for us to keep working, improving its systems, and building an increasingly fun experience.There is still plenty of work to do and lots of news ahead. events.title: The Arsenal is OPEN! ⚔️
events.summary: Heroes, clear some inventory space: the Arsenal is officially open!Sakasmith has spent far too long surrounded by hammers, sparks, and questionable safety decisions. The result? A new place to find gear, power up your party, and turn “We almost had them!” into “Wait… where did the boss go?”Stop by the Arsenal, check out the goods, and prepare your party for the next expedition.Just don’t ask Sakasmith why some of the weapons are still warm. 🔥🔨
